teams.name: Mexico
teams.funFact: Mexico have reached the World Cup knockout stage a record-tying number of times but rarely broken the quarter-final ceiling.
teams.story: Co-hosts and the heartbeat of Group A  -  a nation that lives and breathes the tournament it helped invent the modern atmosphere for.

teams.name: South Korea
teams.funFact: Son Heung-min is chasing the one trophy that has eluded a glittering Premier League career.
teams.story: Forever romantics after 2002, Korea travel with Son's farewell-tour energy and a fearless press.

teams.name: South Africa
teams.funFact: Bafana Bafana remain the only host nation to be eliminated in the group stage (2010)  -  they want to rewrite that story.
teams.story: An underdog with golden-generation flashes, dreaming of a first knockout appearance.

teams.name: Czechia
teams.funFact: Patrik Schick once scored from inside his own half at the Euros  -  Czechia always carry a moment of magic.
teams.story: Heirs to a proud Central European footballing tradition, hunting their first deep run as Czechia.

teams.name: Canada
teams.funFact: Canada are co-hosting their first home World Cup and chasing a first-ever World Cup goal celebration on home soil with fans behind them.
teams.story: Co-hosts with a rocket in Alphonso Davies and a point to prove after a winless 2022.

teams.name: Switzerland
teams.funFact: Switzerland have qualified for every major tournament for over a decade  -  masters of the unglamorous knockout grind.
teams.story: Quietly excellent and forever underestimated, the side that loves a giant-killing.

teams.name: Qatar
teams.funFact: Qatar are the reigning Asian champions, hungry to prove their 2022 host campaign wasn't the full story.
teams.story: Asian kings out to silence the doubters away from home.

teams.name: Bosnia and Herzegovina
teams.funFact: Bosnia's golden generation in 2014 was led by Edin Džeko  -  their legend returned to guide their return.
teams.story: The dragons return to the world stage, armed with defensive grit and a legendary forward in Džeko.

teams.name: Brazil
teams.funFact: Brazil are the only nation to play in every World Cup ever held  -  and the only five-time champions.
teams.story: The most successful nation in history, chasing a sixth star to end a 24-year wait.

teams.name: Morocco
teams.funFact: Morocco became the first African and Arab nation to reach a World Cup semi-final in 2022  -  and they are no longer a surprise.
teams.story: The continent's standard-bearers, carrying a billion dreams and a defence that strangles giants.

teams.name: Haiti
teams.funFact: Haiti's only previous appearance was in West Germany 1974, where they scored a famous goal against Dino Zoff's Italy.
teams.story: Returning after 52 years, Haiti represents the Caribbean's pride and ultimate underdog spirit.

teams.name: Scotland
teams.funFact: Scotland have qualified for their first World Cup since France 1998, ending a 28-year wait.
teams.story: The Tartan Army marches to North America, bringing immense passion, noise, and key Premier League stars.

teams.name: United States
teams.funFact: The USMNT headline their own home World Cup for the first time since 1994  -  and the pressure is enormous.
teams.story: Hosts with a golden generation that finally has to deliver in front of a home crowd.

teams.name: Paraguay
teams.funFact: Paraguay's gritty 2010 side reached the quarter-finals without winning a single knockout game in 90 minutes.
teams.story: Stubborn, streetwise South Americans who make every match a battle.

teams.name: Australia
teams.funFact: The Socceroos' 2022 run was powered by a viral, beer-soaked celebration video back home in Federation Square.
teams.story: Relentless, organised and impossible to dislike  -  the ultimate tournament grinders.

teams.name: Turkiye
teams.funFact: Turkiye's 2002 third-place run included the fastest goal in World Cup history  -  10.8 seconds.
teams.story: A thrilling new generation led by two of Europe's brightest teenagers.

teams.name: Germany
teams.funFact: Germany crashed out in the group stage in BOTH 2018 and 2022  -  a four-time champion in crisis seeks redemption.
teams.story: A fallen giant rebuilt around two of the most exciting playmakers on the planet.

teams.name: Curaçao
teams.funFact: Curaçao has qualified for the World Cup for the first time in their history under a golden Caribbean generation.
teams.story: Debutants bringing Caribbean energy, passion, and tactical flair to Group E.

teams.name: Ivory Coast
teams.funFact: Sébastien Haller scored the winner in the 2023 Africa Cup of Nations final months after beating cancer.
teams.story: African champions riding a wave of one of football's great comeback stories.

teams.name: Ecuador
teams.funFact: Teen prodigy Kendry Páez became one of the youngest scorers in South American qualifying history.
teams.story: Altitude-bred and youthful, with a midfield that giants envy.

teams.name: Netherlands
teams.funFact: The Netherlands are the greatest team to never win the World Cup  -  three finals, three defeats.
teams.story: Total Football's heirs, forever chasing the trophy that history owes them.

teams.name: Japan
teams.funFact: Japan beat both Germany AND Spain in the 2022 group stage  -  then exited on penalties, breaking hearts.
teams.story: Technical, brave and forever knocking on the quarter-final door.

teams.name: Tunisia
teams.funFact: Tunisia shocked reigning champions France 1-0 in Qatar 2022, proving their giant-killing ability.
teams.story: Tactically disciplined and streetwise, the Eagles of Carthage are a tough hurdle for anyone.

teams.name: Sweden
teams.funFact: Sweden reached the quarter-finals in 2018 and boast a frighteningly potent attack for 2026.
teams.story: Scandinavian powerhouses carrying a golden generation of dynamic, clinical attackers.

teams.name: Belgium
teams.funFact: Belgium's 'golden generation' won bronze in 2018 but never the gold  -  this is the last dance for several greats.
teams.story: A team racing against time, blending fading legends with electric new pace.

teams.name: Egypt
teams.funFact: Mohamed Salah carried Egypt to the 2018 World Cup but injury robbed him of his moment  -  he's back for redemption.
teams.story: A pharaoh's last quest: Salah dragging Egypt toward a first knockout stage in the modern era.

teams.name: Iran
teams.funFact: Iran's 1998 win over the USA in Lyon remains one of football's most politically charged matches ever played.
teams.story: Asia's perennial heavyweight, still chasing a first-ever knockout berth.

teams.name: New Zealand
teams.funFact: New Zealand are the only team to leave the 2010 World Cup unbeaten  -  three draws, then knocked out.
teams.story: The ultimate Cinderella, dreaming of a first-ever World Cup win.

teams.name: Spain
teams.funFact: Teenager Lamine Yamal is already being compared to the greatest wingers in history  -  this is his coming-out tournament.
teams.story: Tiki-taka reborn with a fearless teenage generation lighting up the wings.

teams.name: Cape Verde
teams.funFact: The Blue Sharks reached the quarter-finals of the 2023 Africa Cup of Nations, winning hearts globally.
teams.story: The ultimate giant-killers of the Atlantic, ready to unleash their speed and spirit in Group H.

teams.name: Saudi Arabia
teams.funFact: Saudi Arabia stunned eventual champions Argentina 2-1 in 2022  -  one of the greatest upsets in World Cup history.
teams.story: Giant-killers who proved that on the right day, no superpower is safe.

teams.name: Uruguay
teams.funFact: Uruguay, a nation of 3.4 million, has won as many World Cups as England, France and Spain combined  -  two stars on the shirt.
teams.story: History's original champions, still snarling, still punching far above their weight.

teams.name: France
teams.funFact: Kylian Mbappé already has a World Cup final hat-trick (2022)  -  and he's still in his twenties.
teams.story: The most feared attack on earth, captained by a generational superstar in his prime.

teams.name: Senegal
teams.funFact: Senegal's 2002 debut began with a shock win over reigning champions France  -  they love a grand entrance.
teams.story: African powerhouses with speed, steel, and the confidence of a team that fears no one.

teams.name: Norway
teams.funFact: Norway return to the World Cup after a 28-year absence  -  and they're bringing Erling Haaland with them.
teams.story: A goal machine and a captain-artist finally on the biggest stage together.

teams.name: Iraq
teams.funFact: Iraq won the 2007 Asian Cup amid extraordinary adversity  -  one of sport's most moving triumphs.
teams.story: A nation for whom simply being here is a victory, and they want much more.

teams.name: Argentina
teams.funFact: Reigning champions Argentina arrive in a post-Messi-prime world, defending the crown won in the Qatar epic.
teams.story: World champions chasing back-to-back glory  -  the team everyone wants to beat.

teams.name: Algeria
teams.funFact: Algeria pushed eventual champions Germany to extra time in a thrilling 2014 last-16 classic.
teams.story: Technical, proud and capable of toppling anyone on their day.

teams.name: Austria
teams.funFact: Austria's high-pressing system has made them one of Europe's most feared tactical sides.
teams.story: Das Nationalteam travels with cohesion, fire, and a modern press to shake up Group J.

teams.name: Jordan
teams.funFact: Jordan has qualified for their first-ever FIFA World Cup after a historic runners-up finish in the 2023 Asian Cup.
teams.story: The Chivalrous make their World Cup debut, ready to unleash their lethal counter-attacks on the world.

teams.name: Portugal
teams.funFact: Cristiano Ronaldo is the only player to score in five different World Cups  -  this is the final chapter.
teams.story: A legend's last World Cup, surrounded by a frighteningly talented supporting cast.

teams.name: Uzbekistan
teams.funFact: Uzbekistan have qualified for the World Cup for the very first time in their history.
teams.story: Debutants writing the opening page of a brand-new footballing story.

teams.name: Colombia
teams.funFact: James Rodríguez won the 2014 Golden Boot and scored a goal so good it earned a FIFA Puskás Award.
teams.story: Carnival football with a maestro orchestrating one last great campaign.

teams.name: DR Congo
teams.funFact: As Zaire in 1974, they were the first Black African nation to reach a World Cup  -  now they return transformed.
teams.story: A historic name reborn, hungry to honour a pioneering legacy.

teams.name: England
teams.funFact: England's quest to bring football home takes them to North America, aiming to build on deep tournament runs.
teams.story: A golden generation desperate to finally go all the way and win their first trophy since 1966.

teams.name: Croatia
teams.funFact: Luka Modrić, the 2018 Ballon d'Or winner, is chasing one final tournament miracle at 40 years old.
teams.story: The ultimate big-game team  -  small nation, enormous heart, and a maestro's last waltz.

teams.name: Ghana
teams.funFact: Ghana were a Luis Suárez handball away from becoming the first African semi-finalists in 2010  -  the wound still aches.
teams.story: A proud giant chasing the redemption that 2010 cruelly denied them.

teams.name: Panama
teams.funFact: Panama's first-ever World Cup goal in 2018 was treated as a national holiday back home.
teams.story: Tiny nation, massive belief  -  the romantics of Group L.

rivalries.title: England vs Croatia  -  The 2018 Ghost
rivalries.blurb: Moscow, 2018. England led a World Cup semi-final and dared to dream  -  then Croatia broke their hearts in extra time. Eight years on, they meet again.
points: 2018 semi-final: Croatia won 2-1 after extra time
Modrić's last tournament vs Bellingham's first as a star

rivalries.title: USA vs Iran  -  More Than A Game
rivalries.blurb: From the politically-charged 1998 clash in Lyon to the tense 2022 decider, no fixture carries more weight off the pitch than this one.
points: 1998: Iran won 2-1 in an emotional Lyon night

rivalries.title: Uruguay vs Ghana  -  The Suárez Wound
rivalries.blurb: 2010: Luis Suárez's handball on the line denied Ghana a place in history. 2022: Ghana's revenge mission backfired. The trilogy continues.
points: 2010 QF: Suárez handball, Gyan misses the penalty
2022: Uruguay won 2-0 but both went home

rivalries.title: Germany vs Algeria  -  Old Scores
rivalries.blurb: From the 1982 'Disgrace of Gijón' to the 2014 extra-time epic, these two share one of the World Cup's most loaded histories.
points: 1982: Algeria beat West Germany, then the Gijón scandal
2014: Germany edged a classic 2-1 in extra time

moments.text: La Roja produced a controlled 2-0 semi-final win over France to book the first place in the MetLife final.

moments.text: Argentina staged a late comeback to beat England 2-1 and reach another World Cup final.

moments.title: Maradona's Hand of God & Goal of the Century
moments.text: Within four minutes, Diego Maradona produced football's most infamous goal and its most beautiful  -  both against England.

moments.title: The Maracanazo
moments.text: Uruguay silenced 200,000 Brazilians at the Maracanã to win the World Cup in the greatest upset the sport has seen.

moments.title: Argentina 3-3 France  -  The Greatest Final
moments.text: Messi vs Mbappé, a final-hat-trick, and penalties. Many call it the finest World Cup final ever played.

moments.text: On home soil, Brazil suffered the most shocking semi-final collapse in tournament history.

moments.title: Senegal Shock France
moments.text: World Cup debutants Senegal beat the reigning champions in the opening match  -  a statement heard across a continent.

moments.title: Croatia's Run to the Final
moments.text: A nation of four million played three straight knockout games to extra time and reached the final  -  pure defiance.
